anchors.paper_title: A Large Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset
anchors.reason: FACED is a different dataset (123 subjects, 28 video clips) from an overlapping lab; EmoEEG-MC is a separate multi-context dataset, so this is topically related but not its data paper.

anchors.paper_venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
anchors.reason: Bodily maps of emotions (PNAS 2013) is a self-report study of bodily sensation maps, topically related to emotion but not describing the EmoEEG-MC EEG dataset.

metadata.methods_description: Participants completed 21 imagery trials and 21 video trials each, with trial order randomized across participants. Trials covered seven emotion categories and were validated with subjective reports. 64-channel EEG was recorded together with PPG and GSR for some participants. Video stimuli were drawn from the FACED dataset materials.
